'''Grigor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] who served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Lord Grigor was among the Sith forces who, under the command of [[Dark Council]]ors [[Darth Hadra]] and [[Darth Acharon]], was holding off the Republic push on the [[Legislature Building]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the attack he was killed by a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].
